invariants.rationale: If line < 0, cursorLine is set to 0; otherwise, cursorLine remains unchanged or is set based on line.
If line >= getLines(), cursorLine is set to getLines() - 1; otherwise, cursorLine is unchanged or set to line.
If line equals cursorLine, then it must have been an out-of-bounds value; otherwise, it would have entered the third branch and set cursorLine = line.
If line is valid, cursorLine is set to line at method exit; if not, cursorLine becomes clamp value.
